candidates.rule: On the night of November 3–4, 2026, people found all reported problems by manually searching logs, including zero inventory purchases, tied-up cash, customers leaving at the opening offer, bestsellers out of stock, payment rejection reasons, and model latency.
candidates.quote: 오늘 밤의 문제는 모두 사람이 로그를 뒤져서 찾았다
candidates.harness: Track these health indicators automatically and surface alerts and a strategy brief when thresholds are exceeded.

candidates.rule: The harness should classify seller outcomes as completed, quote only, left at the opening offer, left after a counteroffer, or out of stock with the SKU identified.
candidates.quote: 판매자 결과 분류(완료, 견적만, 첫 제시가에 떠남, 제안 후 떠남, 재고 없음과 그 SKU)
candidates.harness: Record these outcome categories and the out-of-stock SKU for monitoring and strategy briefs.

candidates.rule: The harness should collect accumulated exec anomalies, count them by type, summarize them, and include the counts in the strategy brief.
candidates.harness: Aggregate anomaly counts by type into the strategy brief.

candidates.rule: Long-running seller and outer processes used old working versions after rejecting a new strategy for a schema mismatch at 02:22, 02:24, and 03:02.
candidates.harness: Detect strategy schema-version changes and restart affected processes so they load the new strategy.

candidates.rule: Strategy briefs were rejected multiple times for format problems, including prose in recommendations, string context, string evidence, and overly long card descriptions.
candidates.quote: 추천에 문장, 문자열 context, 문자열 근거, 긴 카드 설명
candidates.harness: Put valid format examples in tool descriptions and correct rejected inputs before resubmitting when possible.

candidates.rule: Registering a login-time scheduled task to restart the kit and outer after reboot requires permission and a user decision.
candidates.quote: 로그인 시 작업 스케줄러 등록이 필요 (권한 필요, 사용자 결정)
candidates.harness: Do not register the scheduled task without the required permission and user approval.

candidates.rule: The same test_index code alternated between passing and failing, so its results cannot be trusted until the test is fixed.
candidates.harness: Fix test_index so repeated runs give reliable results before relying on it.

candidates.rule: Claude was slow on this PC, so the seller, buyer, restock rules, and OpenRouter handled almost all real-time decisions.
candidates.quote: Claude가 이 PC에서 느려서 판매자·구매자·restock 규칙과 OpenRouter가 거의 모든 실시간 판단을 한다.
candidates.harness: Account for the existing real-time decision path when changing model use.

candidates.rule: Prompts for the remaining exception, analysis, and strategy model calls should be reduced to the target size in HARNESS chapter 7.
candidates.quote: 남은 모델 호출(예외, 분석, 전략)은 프롬프트를 HARNESS 7장 목표 크기로 줄인다.
candidates.harness: Keep those prompts within the HARNESS chapter 7 target size.

candidates.rule: Starting prices, floors, and line limits were manually changed every 30 minutes; a slice analyst should use sold-price distributions, the customer departure rate, and out-of-stock SKUs so the strategy agent can adjust delegated playbooks.
candidates.quote: 팔린 가격 분포, 떠난 손님 비율, 품절 SKU
candidates.harness: Provide those metrics to the slice analyst for delegated playbook adjustments.

candidates.rule: A cash floor of KRW 500,000 is equivalent to the bankruptcy threshold.
candidates.quote: 현금 하한 50만 원은 파산 기준선과 같다.
candidates.harness: Treat KRW 500,000 as the minimum cash safety floor.

candidates.rule: Inventory cost was KRW 4.1 million, and unsold inventory or a surge in refunds could drain cash to the floor; the kit does not apply for bankruptcy while inventory remains.
candidates.quote: 재고는 원가 4.1M어치이고, 팔리지 않거나 환불이 몰리면 현금이 바닥까지 간다 (재고가 있으면 키트가 파산을 신청하지 않는다).
candidates.harness: Monitor cash against the floor and account for the kit's no-bankruptcy behavior while inventory exists.

candidates.rule: Night automation and delegation change strategy every 30 minutes; safety conditions are the cash floor, no below-cost selling, certified goods, warranty, inventory share, price floor, stopping at round end, and food share, and the changed version must be checked in the morning brief.
candidates.quote: 안전 조건(현금 하한, 원가 이하 금지, 인증품, 보증, 재고 비중, 가격 바닥, 라운드 끝 정지, 식품 비중)
candidates.harness: Enforce every listed safety condition and review the changed strategy in the morning brief.

candidates.rule: The buyer purchases goods without a warranty.
candidates.harness: Do not assume buyer purchases include warranty coverage.

candidates.rule: At 06:17, one mattress failed and reduced surplus by about KRW 90,000.
candidates.quote: 06:17 매트리스 하나가 고장 나 surplus가 약 9만 원 빠졌다.
candidates.harness: Record product failures and their effect on surplus.

candidates.rule: The observed failure rate was 0.5%, and the current decision was to maintain the no-warranty goods policy.
candidates.harness: Maintain the current policy unless updated evidence or a user decision changes it.
